exodus.24.p1.b1.text: Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.

exodus.24.p1.b2.text: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”

exodus.24.p1.b3.text: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, …

exodus.24.p1.b4.text: All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.

exodus.24.p2.b5.text: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD.

exodus.24.p2.b6.text: Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain,

exodus.24.p2.b7.text: … along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

exodus.24.p2.b8.text: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.

exodus.24.p3.b9.text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

exodus.24.p3.b10.text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, …

exodus.24.p3.b11.text: All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.

exodus.24.p3.b12.text: This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.

exodus.24.p4.b13.text: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,

exodus.24.p4.b14.text: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.

exodus.24.p4.b15.text: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.

exodus.24.p5.b16.text: Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.

exodus.24.p5.b17.text: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.

exodus.24.p5.b18.text: Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. …

exodus.24.p6.b19.text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.

exodus.24.p6.b20.text: For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.

exodus.24.p6.b21.text: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
